messages:
deploy-bot: Kicking off staged rollout: edgeflow-service v1.2.0 -> 12% traffic in us-east-1. change-window 2026-03-26 10:00-11:00 UTC. notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/edgeflow/1.2.0

nate: quick glance at SLOs shows a tiny uptick in error responses and a handful of connection timeouts. p99 ~480ms (baseline 170ms), 5xx ~0.6% (baseline 0.04%).

jia: I'm seeing a cluster of traces landing in `stream-handshake` with TLS renegotiation errors. Could be a libssl bump in v1.2.0.

sam: can we shrink the cohort and pin staged traffic back to v1.1.7 while we triage? prefer not to do a full rollback.

ops-bot: Alert: edgeflow-service us-east-1 error-rate exceeded soft threshold (policy=EDGE-5xx). Manual review recommended.

nate: agreed. Jia, can you run the pin? sam, please prepare a short change-window note.

jia: running pin now: ```/release pause service=edgeflow-service cohort=staged version=v1.1.7 reason="TLS renegotiate errors"```

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 12%. Cohort pinned to v1.1.7 for staged traffic. action_id=rl-4987654321-pause

devops-bot: Routing swap applied. 12% cohort now routed to v1.1.7. Telemetry will backfill in ~50s.

ops-bot: Confirmed: 5xx dropping after pin, p99 returning toward baseline. Good rollback signal.

nate: I'll collect TLS/connection traces and verify libssl versions across hosts. Jia, if it's the lib bump, can we cut v1.2.1 without the change and run a 1% micro-probe behind a feature flag?

jia: yes. Preliminary triage in progress; will post a short summary in 20m. If it's an infra config issue (nginx TLS settings), we can roll that out infra-side and unlatch v1.2.0.

sam: adding an addendum to the change-window and release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/edgeflow/1.2.0/notes (editing)

ops-bot: FYI flagged for postmortem if we confirm regression. Created tag PM-4987654321.

deploy-bot: Retaining staged cohort pinned state until explicit resume. To resume use `/release resume service=edgeflow-service cohort=staged` (requires approver).

jia: assigning trace triage to @nate and myself. Will update when we have root cause and proposed fix plan.

sam: thanks everyone. Monitoring the window and standing by for the fix. :white_check_mark:
